title: French Pine and Nut Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry dish with the nutty taste of pine nuts and smoky flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the bacon and cook until crispy, then remove and set aside.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the pine nuts and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fresh pine and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Return the bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
